page.text:
Intuitively, two pairs $(n_1, m_1)$ and $(n_2, m_2)$ represent the same
integer difference when $n_1 - m_1 = n_2 - m_2$. Because subtraction is
not yet defined, we rearrange this equation using addition alone into the
equivalent *cross-sum condition*: $$n_1 + m_2 = n_2 + m_1$$ This relation
is reflexive, symmetric, and transitive, forming a valid equivalence
relation on $\mathbb{N} \times \mathbb{N}$.
